X3: the reported quantity is by design an expected maximum over B online-evaluated policies (best of B hyperparameter settings), coded yes though it is explicit and is the paper's point. Y3: Walker2d, Hopper, HalfCheetah (from Qin et al. data) plus CityLearn, FinRL, Industrial Benchmark = 6. Y5: BC's implementation origin is never stated, so no.
